profile.belief: I’ve always been very intertwined with the Industry growing up and both myself and my family have always been huge animation fans with some family members working it in. I’ve always wanted to work in entertainment, more specifically in the animation field, but behind the microphone rather than in front of it. I truly believe that the most magical and influential medium in entertainment is animation and would love to keep working in it for the rest of my life!
profile.working_on: I would love to be a voice over casting director  with my own agency or being an executive in-house casting director for a company like Pixar or Dreamworks.
